semiconductor_relevance: High — Scientech Corporation is a well-established supplier of semiconductor equipment and services, including manufacturing and reclaiming processes critical to the semiconductor value chain.
summary: Scientech Corporation specializes in the sales and manufacturing of semiconductor equipment, including wet-process tools and metrology systems. The company also provides wafer reclaim services and has expanded into advanced packaging, supporting various segments of the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Development of TBDB temporary bonding/debonding systems
Sales and marketing of used semiconductor tools

regional_presence.Taiwan: Scientech has a significant presence in Taiwan, with a manufacturing facility in Hsinchu Hukou and a strong reputation in the local semiconductor market.
regional_presence.China: The company operates multiple offices across major Chinese cities, including Beijing and Shanghai, to support its sales and service operations.
